svg.title: Blueprint 6 — Three-Tier Privacy Gate, Bulk Visibility & Shared Collection Access Matrix
svg.desc: Access control and visibility matrix diagram for iqoqo v1.2.0 showing private, friends_only, and public item states, three mutation paths including bulk visibility fan-out, and the SharedCollection visibility_scope evaluation table with Friend Bonus.
svg.text: Blueprint 6 — Three-Tier Privacy Gate, Bulk Visibility & Shared Collection Access Matrix
iqoqo v1.2.0 • Item Visibility States, BOLA Guards, Atomic Bulk Mutations & SharedCollection Friend Bonus Evaluation

g.text: • Audience: Owner only (+ Admin custody maintenance tools)
• Excluded from public grids, /u/<username>, default SPARQL snapshots & RSS
• Visible via Share Link ONLY if visibility_scope == "all"
• Audience: Owner + mutually accepted Friends (user_friendships local
• Unlocked on public_only share links via Friend Bonus
• Indexed in Search / AI sitemaps & feeds when User.visibility == "public"
• Safe default keeps new personal shelves private
Sidebar Visibility facet + BulkItemVisibilityToolbar → BulkItemVisibilitySchema (1..100 owned physical items)
Atomic ownership check prevents 404/403 existence oracle; commits & fans out to 5 subsystems:
+ full edit UI on own shelf
Revocable at any time by owner
